name: mucin 6, oligomeric mucus/gel-forming (gene/pseudogene)

function.text: MUC6 encodes mucin-6. Annotated molecular activities include extracellular matrix structural constituent. It participates in maintenance of gastrointestinal epithelium.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Acute Myeloid Leukemia; Hepatocellular Carcinoma; Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
